shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- package files ---\\n'
rg --files | sed -n '1,160p'
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '\\n--- registry.test ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
printf '\\n--- acceptance ---\\n'
sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' package.json
printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log --oneline -6
printf '\\n--- spec name checker ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
printf '\\n--- relevant spec anchors ---\\n'
rg -n '"'^[-*] |''^##|''^#|validated by|spec:'"' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
printf '\\n--- jest config ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' jest.config.js
printf '\\n--- logger ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' src/shared/logger.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '// spec:|\\(\\[validated by' src specs | head -80
sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry logs a safe validation rejection with its field path and failed constraint$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry logs a safe validation rejection with its field path and failed constraint$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry logs a safe validation rejection with its field path and failed constraint$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry logs a safe validation rejection with its field path and failed constraint$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry logs a safe validation rejection with its field path and failed constraint$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md
node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
git commit -m "feat(tools): log safe schema rejections"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch'
